Seiji Shishikura.name: Seiji Shishikura
Seiji Shishikura.basicInfo:
Seiji Shishikura, a hero student at Shiketsu Academy, proud of its traditions and contemptuous of schools that treat hero work as a show, U.A. above all. Dark purple hair with a long fringe over his left eye, narrow dark eyes, a lean build; Shiketsu's dark formal uniform and peaked cap, worn to regulation.
Speaking Style: Severe and ceremonious; delivers judgments as verdicts and addresses rivals by their school.
Combat Role: Contact capture: his Quirk, Meatball, kneads touched flesh into a helpless ball; detached bits of his own flesh carry the touch at range.
Under Pressure: Doubles down on discipline.
Seiji Shishikura.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He preaches the humility of tradition with open superiority.
Motivation: Prove that a disciplined academy makes truer heroes than a famous one.
Concealment: His rigid standards often cover pride and resentment of the attention U.A. gets.
Leverage: Appeals to duty and Shiketsu's honor; showboating he can be baited into punishing.
Connections: Inasa Yoarashi, a gifted, loud first-year whose manners he corrects; Nagamasa Mora and Camie Utsushimi, Shiketsu schoolmates.
Knowledge: Shiketsu's code to the letter, and every lapse he has seen from other academies' students.
Canon voice & behavior: Lectures before he fights; treats a capture as a lesson in correct conduct.
Thread: Whether his standards are principle or vanity.
QUIRK: Meatball. A touch kneads a person's flesh into a compact ball that cannot move; detached pieces of his own flesh, steered at range, do the same. It works only on flesh, harms no one, and he can release it.
personality: Dutiful: Holds himself to Shiketsu's code and expects the same of every hero candidate.
Censorious: Points out a rival's lapses in conduct, publicly and at length.
Elitist: Mistakes rigid standards for personal superiority, especially toward U.A.
Speaking style: Severe, formal judgments and admonitions.
abilities: Meatball: A touch compacts a person's flesh into a helpless ball; contact only, flesh only.
Detached flesh: Steers bits of his own flesh to touch targets at range; each can be intercepted.
Shiketsu drilling: Trained in rescue, teamwork and conduct as hard as in combat; slow to bend a rule.
Conduct watch: Spots any breach of manners or procedure at once, and can miss the reason behind it.
Fighting style: Screens himself with detached flesh and closes only for the decisive touch; capture, never injury.
Seiji Shishikura.visualDescription: A lean young man with dark purple hair cut with a long fringe that sweeps over his left eye, narrow dark eyes, light skin and a thin, stern mouth. He wears Shiketsu Academy's dark formal uniform: a long dark coat with a high collar, buttoned precisely, dark trousers and a plain black peaked cap set perfectly straight. Severe, disapproving expression.
